details:
For some context I've played the game for several years now, my account age is 8 years and I've been a big enjoyer of the game for a really long time. I think the platform is very special and I want it to thrive and continue to grow so this feed back comes from a place of respect for the time and dedication you put into the platform.

I don't tend to join public worlds, I've always enjoyed world hopping to new experiences with my close group of friends. Finding new worlds and being awestruck at the amazing new experiences people have created has always been my favourite way to play the game. I've even recently picked up world creation myself to give back the same experiences that have kept me company the last couple years.

However nowadays it's gotten increasingly hard to find new world's that scratch this itch I've been looking for, and I'm sure many have felt the same way. That's why the community has been so vocal about a likes and dislikes feature. It's not just to combat AI-generated worlds; its to help combat the rise of low quality "meme" worlds and generic retextured assets, as well as to help rise up and shine a light to those amazing worlds that have yet to be discovered.

I am really grateful that you guys have worked so quickly to make the likes/dislike feature a reality, however I feel that it could be improved upon to help appease both sides of the debate.

First off it would be amazing if we could get a new featured world playlist that refreshes every day and includes the top 100 liked worlds of the previous day, in my mind the likes would only count for one day so that for example if a world gets 100 likes on one day but only 3 on the next day then it wouldn't be featured again. New and noteworthy would still remain the same as it always has, showcasing a consistent light over popular new worlds but this new playlist would serve to showcase brand new worlds that people have yet to check out.

I can understand not wanting to publicly showcase dislikes on a world, the fear of trolls mass disliking a world manually or with bots would be discouraging for new and returning world creators. What I'm proposing is that everyone can like and dislike a world as they are able to now, but public dislikes are only shown from players who have earned the "known user" or "trusted user" tag. By only showcasing the dislikes from active players of the game it can be ensured that the dislikes are only from real players who are just trying to give their honest review of a world.

Thank you for the work you put into the game and thank you for reading this far!
title: [1948] Alternate take on the likes and dislikes system
